editorial.blurb: Birria Huentitan brings authentic Mexican flavors and late-night cravings together with world-class birria, cabeza, and crispy quesabirria tacos that keep Chicago coming back.
editorial.insiderTip: Go late night when the birria is at its peak, and don't skip the cabeza—reviewers call it world-class. Order the queso and chips as a must-try appetizer.

topDishes.note: World-class, a standout even among their excellent offerings
Crispy, cheesy, and rich with generous portions
Massive and perfectly cooked with bright, fresh sauces on the side
